concepts.title: Income vs Expenses
concepts.description: Income is all money flowing in (allowance, part-time shifts). Expenses are cash flowing out. Golden rule: never let monthly outflow exceed verified inflow.

concepts.title: The 50/30/20 Rule
concepts.description: A stress-free ratio: 50% for core needs (dorm, groceries), 30% for guilt-free lifestyle fun, and 20% reserved for savings or wiping out debt.

concepts.title: Avoid Impulse Buys
concepts.description: Practice the 24-Hour Rule: wait a full day before purchasing any non-essential item. If the urge fades, you just protected valuable student savings.
